gtmApiKey.title: gtm-api key
gtmApiKey.description: API key from app.gtm-api.com (7-day trial, no card). Sent to the hosted endpoint as an Authorization bearer. Callers can also pass a key per request via the x-gtm-api-key header or the gtm_api_key query parameter.

upstreamUrl.title: Upstream MCP endpoint
upstreamUrl.description: Hosted streamable-http endpoint this Actor bridges to. Leave the default unless gtm-api support tells you otherwise.
